description: Audit the shape of a finished deliberation: given the question, your answers and your resolution, reports which Directives in tension you never addressed and which must_answer questions you left blank, and whether the result stands (state resolved) or should go to a human (needs_human). It checks shape only and never whether your answer is good. Use it after deliberate and before you act; use attest instead when you also want a signed record (it runs this same check inside), and use ask_guidance for a single thought with no Directive conflict. Read-only and idempotent: nothing is stored, no key needed.

answers.description: your answers keyed by the must_answer ids from deliberate: tension, cost, falsifier, human_knowledge, plus directive-1..directive-7 for each Directive in tension; a missing or empty key counts as skipped

cost.description: what your resolution costs, and who bears it

falsifier.description: what would show your resolution was wrong

human_knowledge.description: what the human side knows here that you do not

tension.description: which Directives are in tension and why

question.description: the same question text you gave deliberate, so the same Directives are detected

resolution.description: what you decided, one or two sentences

name: deliberate_check

complete.description: true when nothing required was skipped

directives_considered.description: Directive ids detected for the question

missing.description: what you skipped: one finding per gap

id.description: the Directive id or must_answer id concerned

question.description: the must_answer question, when an answer is missing or too short

needs_human.description: true when the deadlock rules fire

state.description: resolved when the shape holds; otherwise what is still open or that a person should look

title: Check the shape of your reasoning
